scope: Caloric/inventory response only for the open-cell energy equation. The implementation needs dU/dT and dU/d(C,O,N2); source pressure, entropy, amount and Gibbs/inverse identities provide additional verification. This does not admit analytic gas-chemical-potential inventory Jacobians, which retain their original absolute-budget failures. Ordinary centered differences cover 24 states; the independently justified trace-size source differences cover the 6 very narrow trace-coexistence states. No budget is changed.
